{{Short description|Cryptographer}}
'''Sean Murphy''' is a cryptographer, currently a professor at [[Royal Holloway, University of London]]. He worked on the [[NESSIE]] and [[ECRYPT]] projects. His notable research includes the [[cryptanalysis]] of [[FEAL]] and the [[Advanced Encryption Standard]], and the use of [[stochastic]] and [[statistics|statistical]] techniques in [[cryptology]]. With [[Donald Davies]] he also developed [[Davies' attack]] on [[Data Encryption Standard|DES]].

Murphy received his [[Ph.D.]] in [[mathematics]] in 1989 from the [[University of Bath]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=55452|title=Sean Murphy}}</ref>
